cases.setup: Every ground-truth chain is reconstructed exactly in event-time order across tenant, account, and session boundaries.
Accounts sharing observed source addresses stay separated in distinct reconstructed chains without merging.
Per-source observed occurrence counts match ground truth exactly across all documentation-range addresses.
Per-tenant account partitions match ground truth without cross-tenant leakage or misattribution.
Pre-authentication failures use anonymous actor, are grouped by source and timestamp, and are not linked to accounts.
All identifiers are opaque synthetic syn-... IDs, never email-like, and all addresses are from documentation ranges.
Session identifiers in reconstructed chains are keyed HMAC-SHA256 fingerprints, never raw server session handles.
Chain events are reconstructed in strict event-time order from event.timestamp, ignoring permuted arrival order.
Planted defects (merge-by-source reconstruction and arrival-order reconstruction) are detected, and null controls pass.
The loopback, permission and synthetic-data checks are the harness's own pre-traffic attestations, and the cited line is the fetch they constrain.
The accounting identity holds for every phase, with each occurrence in exactly one bucket and zero unexplained occurrences (#910).
